title: Private Sea to Sky Gondola & Squamish Scenic Tour from Vancouver
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover a 6-hour private adventure from Vancouver along the scenic Sea-to-Sky Highway — designed entirely for your group.

Take in stunning ocean-and-mountain views, stop at the base of Shannon Falls, and ride the Sea to Sky Gondola for panoramic vistas over Howe Sound. You’ll also explore the dramatic landscapes of Squamish Canyon and visit Mamquam Falls — a hidden gem tucked in peaceful forest surroundings.

This tour is all about comfort, flexibility, and authentic experiences.
Set the pace, choose your stops, and enjoy a stress-free journey guided by a knowledgeable local. Perfect for couples, families with kids, photographers, and nature lovers.

Private Tour Highlights

* Just your group — fully personalized
* Flexible stops — your call
* Optional extra time available
* Great for families, couples & private groups
* Snacks, water & soft drinks included
